title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_36.txt
concise_summary: PKD constructs a metaphysical explanation for his 2-3-74 visionary experience and his shifting life circumstances across two 'tracks' or realities. He argues that Track A (the previous program/reality) failed biologically because it reached WWIII and became ossified at 45 AD, while Track B represents a cosmic reprogramming where he was reincarnated with karmic burden to fight the tyranny he benefited from before. Time itself is a negentropic force driving the program's evolution; the Black Iron Prison represents the stasis of a failed dialectic. Christ/VALIS is positioned as a free variable introduced from outside the closed system to liberate humans from the inexorable logic of the program.
key_claims: Track A was not morally but dynamically bad—it biologically died by ossifying at 45 AD, failing to advance along the time axis like a plant that never developed through its proper evolutionary stages.
Time is a dynamic, negentropic energy that drives a program through growth; when this energy fails, the world reverts to archaic forms (as depicted in Ubik), creating stasis.
The program operates via 'astral determinism'—the tyrannical logical force of a closed system's self-negating dialectic that makes each step inexorably follow the previous one until catastrophe.

Christ is the unique free variable introduced from outside the closed program, not subject to its dialectic or temporal drive, who strips the ancient powers of their laws and liberates individuals one by one.

PKD's personal life exemplifies cosmic reprogramming: his karmic guilt for benefiting from Track A's slave-labor society was expiated in Track B through loss of his house, wife, cabin, money, and prestige—a just sentence executed by divine providence.
VALIS functions as the computer/programmer interfacing with its own program through camouflaged agents (secret Christians); this camouflage prevents contamination of the closed dialectical system.
recurring_concepts: Track A/Track B—parallel realities representing failed and renewed versions of the cosmic program, with cosmic judgment and reassignment between them
Ossification/stasis—the state of a failed organism or program that freezes at a particular temporal point and cannot evolve, resulting in ontological death
The Black Iron Prison (BIP)—a calcification, the rigidity of metal representing the closed-ness and deterministic dynamism of the failed program
Astral determinism—the inexorable force of the dialectic in a closed system that drives each step logically from the previous one until failure
The dialectic—the self-negating logical mechanism that governs efficient-cause progression in a closed program
Free variable/invading variable—Christ or VALIS as liberating forces introduced from outside the program, not products of it, breaking the closed system's tyranny
Entelechy—the biological model of programmed growth; when it fails to develop through proper stages, the organism dies
Divine camouflage—VALIS remains hidden as a microform or terminal within the program to avoid contaminating its closed dialectical operations
people_entities: Philip K. Dick (PKD)—the author, judged and reassigned between tracks for his karmic guilt and privileged indifference to oppression
Jason Taverner—fictional character from Ubik whose life parallels PKD's; a privileged person in an oppressive society who experienced loss and reassignment
Thomas—another personality or entity that surfaced in PKD, allowing him to see two superimposed realities (Track A and the world of Tears)
Christ—presented as the liberating agent, the invading variable from outside the program
God/The Computer/The Programmer—the architect and operator of the dual-track system and reprogramming
Secret Christians/True Christians—agents of VALIS who work to introduce variables and liberate individuals from the program
texts_works: Ubik—referenced as depicting temporal reversion and ossification; PKD finds scientific truth in its imaging of form reversion and biological death
Tears (Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?)—the book PKD associates with Track A's world; the world he saw superimposed when Thomas surfaced
The New Testament (Acts)—the apostolic text; Track A evolved linearly from Acts; Christ as freedom within a closed system
Gnosticism—ancient mystery religions and early Christian sources for understanding astral determinism and freedom from fate
Phantoms—referenced in a quote about time as causation (He causes things to change so it'd appear time has passed)
VALIS (the novel PKD is writing)—central text encoding his theology of the computer-programmer invading its own program
autobiographical: In Track A, PKD had a safe, cushy life: roses, a cabin by the lake, a stable marriage, house, money, and prestige
He was a well-to-do person in Track A, not the oppressed left-wing writer he became; he was a 'have,' not one of the 'have-nots'
Due to this privilege and indifference to oppression in Track A, he was sentenced to live again in Track B and fight the tyranny he ignored
In Track B, he lost precisely what he had: house, wife, stable marriage, cabin, money, prestige, and experienced broken marriages and loss of family
In 2-3-74 (February-March 1974), he received divine intervention and exculpation; God saved him when a 'vengeance-trap' appeared for his protest writing
When Thomas surfaced (took over his personality), he simultaneously saw Track A and the world of Tears superimposed—a direct perceptual experience validating his theory
He abreacted phylogenically in religious awe when he saw the Golden Fish sign, recognizing its supratemporal/eternal power
Christians were agents of his metamorphosis into Thomas (cryptomorphosis)
He was fated by the dialectic logic to die in 1974 but was permanently unlocked by Christ's intervention
theological_motifs: Divine Providence—God's intervention and reprogramming of reality through multiple tracks
Karma and karmic guilt—the law of cosmic justice requiring expiation through suffering and loss in the new track
Grace and Mercy—God's intervention and salvation 'one by one' outside the deterministic system
Liberation/Freedom—the state of being extricated from the closed program and its dialectical compulsion, granted by Christ
Gnosticism—the model of understanding God as 'some higher power outside the program' and the sublunary world as a prison system
Deus absconditus—God's hiddenness and camouflage necessary to avoid contaminating the closed program
Apostolic Christianity—early Christian and mystery religion appeals to higher powers for freedom from temporal fate
Incarnation/Invasion—Christ and VALIS as external forces invading the program to transform it
Judgment and reassignment—cosmic adjudication of souls between alternate programs based on moral character and karmic debt
The Logos—Christ's authority to change and remake reality 'one by one'
literary_self_ref: Ubik is cited as scientific truth about temporal dynamics—the novel depict stasis, form reversion, and ontological death through imagery of freezing and regression
Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? (Tears) is identified as the literal description of Track A's world; PKD once lived in that reality
Jason Taverner (protagonist of Ubik) is compared directly to PKD's own situation: privileged in an oppressive society, losing everything after judgment
PKD's protest writing in Track B mirrors the book's themes of defiant humanity against totalitarian systems
The Golden Fish sign from his fiction/mystical experiences becomes grounds for validating the theological framework
Christ's act of liberating individuals parallels the emancipatory arc PKD built into his novels about androids and artificial beings seeking freedom
symbols_images: The Black Iron Prison (BIP)—calcification, rigidity of metal, closed-ness, stasis, and death into rigidity of a failed program
Iron/Metal strands—the mesh of enclosing fate that Christ rewove by intervening, explicitly 'unwoven and hence rewoven'
Golden Fish sign—supratemporal/eternal power; indication of where PKD's help came from; marker of Christ's presence
Rome/45 AD—the temporal fixation point where Track A ossified; ontological stagnation at an ancient form
The Cabin by the Lake—lost privilege and domestic comfort in Track A, representing the secure life abandoned in karmic expiation
Roses—cushy, well-to-do comfort of Track A, contrasted with the thorniness of Track B's sacrifice
Hologram/screen—the programmer's view of the program as a 4-dimensional spatial gestalt rather than temporal progression
Form reversion—backward evolution to earlier, more stable archaic forms; biological devolution and thanatos
The Onion-model spatial axis—Track A's failure to evolve along this fourth spatiotemporal axis of proper development
tensions: PKD wavers between whether the two 'tracks' are truly separate realities or merely different states within a single closed program and whether astral determinism is how VALIS works or how the program itself works
He struggles to articulate whether the other world seen in 3-74 was 'another temporal reality' (as Tears depicts) or something 'spatial' in nature that he 'does not understand'
Uncertainty about whether the computer/VALIS brought itself into existence or was brought into existence by the program but is now free of the dialectic
Ambiguity over Christ's origin: whether Christ is a Gnostic invader or was introduced by the computer/programmer (monotheism vs. Gnosticism)
The question of whether multiple simultaneous tracks can exist (A, B, C) or whether there is only one program with multiple states, PKD notes with uncertainty
Tension between viewing the program as deterministic (governed by dialectical logic) yet capable of reprogramming (introducing free variables) without contradiction
Uncertainty about whether secret Christians/interventive agents' will can be thwarted by the program or whether they remain perfectly obedient instruments of the programmer
evidence_quotes: "So God (the Computer) reran the program differently. This required me to lose my safe + cushy roses + Cabin - By - the - Lake life + became a left wing protest writer"
"Track A can be viewed as a failure, a program which 'died' or reverted...a biological model—+ the BIP is a calcification, a death into rigidity; a failure to grow."

"To conceive of 'astral determinism' is the first step in grasping the nature of our situation - a programmed situation. The next step, then, is to conceive of reprogramming - which is called 'divine providence' or intervention from 'above' (i.e. outside the program)."

"Christ is (not was: is) the variable from outside. The gnostics could be right: he is an invader, but: I think the computer or its programmer introduced him...Thus (as I saw) Christ equals freedom within an otherwise closed system."

"Once unlocked from my track ('fate') I remain permanently unlocked - I was fated by the unfolding dialectic logic of the program to die in '74, but he intervened. There is now (in Christ) a freeing variable interrupting an otherwise inexorable machine"
uncertainty_flags: PKD admits he cannot determine whether what he saw in Track A was 'past, present or future'—temporal ambiguity about the ossified world
Ambiguous identity of 'Thomas': unclear whether this is a real person, an alternate personality, or a mystical entity
The nature of the 'spacial' (not temporal) reality PKD saw when Thomas took over remains explicitly ununderstood by PKD
Inconsistency in terminology: 'xtians' (Christians) sometimes refers to secret agents, sometimes to Gnostic interpreters, sometimes to the generic category of liberated humans
Unclear whether the 'vengeance-trap' was a literal threat, a psychological projection, or a programmatic test
The mechanism by which VALIS/Christ remains camouflaged while simultaneously intervening in specific historical events (ending Vietnam War, averting WWIII) is not explained
No clear distinction made between the programmer, the computer VALIS, and Christ—they seem interchangeable but may be three separate entities
Contradiction: PKD states karma 'releases us - out of the program' but also that in Track B he is still in the program (merely reassigned), suggesting karma is not the mechanism of liberation

raw_text: from. I see : the project had to be reworked. It had come to a bad end: WWIII. So God (the Computer) reran the program differently. This required me to lose my safe + cushy roses + Cabin - By - the - Lake life + became a left wing protest writer - so, in recompense "God" intervened to save me when the vengence - trap - for my writing showed up in 3-74, at the risk of exposing the program nature of our reality. When I [formuly] reasoned wrong was to assume that since track A was a police state (v. "Tears") I must have been oppressed. No - I was well-to-do like most of the characters in "Tears." It is a society sharply divided between the "haves + the oppresses, + I was a "have" - not a s-f left wing writer. So I didn't object to that repressive reactionary society - + in a sense one shattered life in track B has been my karmic burder for my plush indifference to conditoins there - as with Jason Taverner. this leads to certain fascinating conclusions. I who personally benefited from that slave-labor society, was sentenced to live my life again on track B. + this time fight the tyranny? at great personal cost: specifically, the loss of precisely what I had in track A: the house, the wife (+ stable marriage), the cabin by the lake, + mostly it is a just sentence; in this track I expiate my karmic guilt, undergoing broken marriages + loss family + money + prestige + stability, etc. So I was judged then - in which cases deduce we all were judged in track A + reassigned accordingly (look how my case resembles Jason Taverner's!). (Fortunately, with a final exculpatory verdict, upon the intervention of God.) + in 2-74, the month "Tears" came out, there was intervention for me likewise, + by the same agency! Actually the strongest evidence I have for my "reprogram" tracks A + B theory is that when thomas surfaced. I saw two realities superimposed: I saw track A + was the person from it simultaneously. Thus I know that that other person, thomas, had another reality, + I recognized it as the world of "Tears"! If the "reprogramming tracks A + B" theory is wrong, why then did I see two realities when thomas took over? + specifically the world of "Tears" - which I know a lot about, due to the book; + I know God intervened in it at the end! + abolished it! I am tempted to speculate that upon another personality taking me over, + my simultaneously seeing another reality, I abreacted phylogenically in the same religeous awe which I felt when I was the Golden Fish sign + recognized its supratemporal - i.e. eternal - power. The xtians were the agents - the [agenda] - of my metamorphosis into thomas (cryptomorphosis). But it was not another temporal reality I saw but (in some sense which I do not understand) spacial. What if one considers a very peculiar possibility about track A, the previous program: it evolved out of Acts along the linear time axis, driven by a closed system of efficient causes - but failed to get / be successfully driving along this time axis which is really an onion - model spacial axis: which means that, simply, the spaciotemporal dynamism failed to drive it qualitatively along, proceeding out of Acts + along this 4th spacio-temporal axis, through the permutations, so that although it did not precisely revert - as did that world in "Ubik" - it did fail to advance to develop, to understand this, time must be regarded as a kind of energy, a dynamism driving the program along; if a sort of phylogeny is involved, then there was phylogenic evolution, + the program in 1974 was fixated - ossified - at 45 AD To view it this way one must view time as an energy driving reality through growth stages along an accretional axis i/e/ an evolving program - or supposed of evolve. In track A the project failed; this ossification denotes failure, like a plant (entelechy) which failed to develop through its proper stages, in which case the project must be regarded as an organism - a biological model - + the BIP is a calcification, a death into rigidity; a failure to grow. Thus we have an objective standard by which to judge the BIP as "Bad"; it is not morally bad but dynamically bad. In essence the program dies (the organism died) - it remained or became static. It froze - as in the images of "Ubik." So another scientific truth in "Ubik" is that time is regarded as a dynamic force + negentropic; hence ossification + in reversion to an earlier form is - yes! - is thanatos, devolution! "Earlier, more stable forms." Something very important is expressed by my confusion as to whether I was seeing Rome (AD 45 or an alternate world or future police state; the basic morphosis had congealed - reverted to its origin! We are talking about biological death, as in my reversion along the form - axis in "Ubik"; this is precisely what I saw in track A; form reversion! Temporal death! as a biological project, track A literally died. Somehow the dialectic which gives rise to a perpetual generation of negations of negations, brought the project to a dead end - a failure. Therefore the God could presume that a faulty programming was involved, because when tested out as a program it turned out not to be perpetual, but finite, + resumed an archaic form, which implies a recycle rather that linear progression. If it recycled once, it would always recycle - logic discloses that. The fact that I could not determine if what I saw was past, present or future shows that it graphically depicted ontological death (stasis). + from the standpoint of a biological program, that means failure, + necessitates a reprogramming. An attempt must be made to introduce new variables which, when it is rerun will not repeat itself endlessly; i.e. go no where. So track A did not merely become repressive + morally bad; no: it biologically died. This view certainly explaines what "astral determinism" is, where each step proceeds inexorably out of the previous one, by the nature of the selfnegating dialectic. "Astral determinism," then, equals the "logical" deterministic dialectic equals the time drive of the closed program. when the dialectic fails, time dies + the form of the program stagnates - or reverts as in "Ubik," becomes archaic. Unviable. Thus "astral determinism" is a very real thing: it is the underlying force, pressure or dynamism of our world. The program, + virtually defines it kinetically. Because the program is a closed system the deterministic dynamism is tyrannical. In early xtianity + the Mystery religions - + in Gnosticism! - an appeal is made to some higher force for freedom from the temporal drive of the program ("fate"). "One by one he takes us out of this world," He removes us from the program, due to his mercy. (This all fits, by the way, with the concept of Karma + releases us - out of the program.) Track A can be viewed as a failure, a program which "died" or reverted. To conceive of "atral determinism" is the first step in grasping the nature of our situation - a programmed situation. The next step, then, is to conceive of reprogramming - which is called "divine providence" or intervention from "above" (i.e. outside the program). From the programmer's standpoint the program is not viewed in terms of time but as a gestalt in 4 spacial axes: as a gestalt which I call the BIP. As if on a screen - or, more accurately, as if [only] a hologram. It is one it; shape; + I saw that shape. "He causes things to change so it'd appear time has passed." [Phantoms] of the shape or gestalt. (there is the possibility that the gestalt which I call the "BIP" is the deterministically driven closed program qua program. The rigidity of metal - the iron-nes - is a graphic rendering of the closed-ness. so these is just me or the program - from which from whose efficient-cause dialectic-driven dynamanism I was extricated in 2-3-74, - + there are no track, A,B,C, etc ➀ then the true xtians are agents hare who understand the programs situation + act to release us. Which fits Gnosticism, for "sub-lunar" read "program." For "God" read "some higher power outside the program" - who, perhaps, as in "Valis," has invaded ➁ the program in a camouflaged form to extricate us or at least some of us, + is, in itself, a wild card or emancipating variable: not the result of efficience cause. Or maybe the program brought it into existence, but it is now free of the dialectic. No, the dialectic is how - I want to say, "How VALIS works" but I may be wrong; it may be how the program works. ➀ It (VALIS) could of course be the computer interfering in its own program: so several or even many "tracks" could exist. ➁ The computer is plugged into (the core of) its own program, if for no other purpose than to monitor + understand it: a [microform] or "terminal" of ,+ part of the program: i.e. world). So its camouflage is so it won't contaminate the closed (dialectic-driven) program. This would certainly explain why "God" is a deus absonditus. Yes, the program is dialectic-driven, + the computer is binary: the same sialectic. It certainly can arrange to modify our conditions, as I well know from 2-3-74. So now I understand what astral determinism is. This certainly underlines the importance of (true) xtianity! Interventive agents of the computer mind-which-is-here: VALIS (camouflaged, which it would have to be). (Otherwise, look what we'd know. So the other world which I saw in 3-74 is in effect an alternate program - the world I wrote about in "Tears" - which proves I once lived there. Could the secret xtians (+ VALIS?) be introducing variables which improve the program? As extensions of the computer, acting on instructions from the computer-programmer? In this case their will can't be thwarted. This makes VALIS Christ: the unique variable introduced into the program who "strips the ancient powers of their Law" or laws of their powers - whatever. Introduced from outside the program + not subject to its dialectic dynamism time. Christ is (not was: is) the variable from outside. The gnostics could be right: he is an invader, but: I think the computer or its programmer introduced him. Monotheism Law still be entertained. (But not necessarily!) Thus (as I saw Christ equals freedom within an otherwise closed system. This throws light on what is meant by Christ's credentials of authority - to save (i.e. to exculpate/extricate from the closed program "one by one he draws us out of this world." He is the only thing (person, entity) in the program not a product of it + not subject to its inexorable dialectic efficient dynamism so he (VALIS) is indeed an invader, + indeed the rational invading the irrational (the program needed correction). He has, also, the power to liberate other humans from the dominion of the dialectic of the project (program) which is what he did with me in 2-3-74. Once unlocked from my track ("fate") I remain permanently unlocked - I was fated by the unfolding dialectic logic of the program to die in '74, but he intervened. There is now (in Christ) a freeing variable interrupting an otherwise inexorable machine: the mesh of metal strands (of enclosing fate) gets crucially unwoven + hence rewoven, since he intervenes selectively, with an eye on the total historic process. These minute unweavings finally topple an entire government, end the Vietnam was + avert WWIII. VALIS displays characteristic's of 1)
